description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the Employees module in SuiteCRM. It contains various test methods verifying the behavior of Employee bean functionalities, including creation, retrieval, list view data, export query, and error display. The class extends a custom test framework and uses BeanFactory to instantiate Employee beans for testing.
